Variants.Content: Beauty Set is a town in the west of the Riverlands. Its name carries the soft colors of folklore, but it is actually built on simple conditions such as rivers, roads and markets. Merchants here purchase grain, wool, leather and river fresh food, craftsmen repair wheels, horse hooves and agricultural tools, and surrounding farmers bring their harvests to the market day to be exchanged for salt, iron and cloth. The Riverlands have no solid natural borders, so towns are places where wealth flows, and they can also be targets for food expropriation, resettlement of refugees, or plunder in times of war. The Collection of Beauties need not be written as a doomed ruin or a place of prosperity; it is first and foremost a place where a group of people tried repeatedly to turn riverside agriculture into life.

Entry Fairmarket Local families also relied on river transportation, ferries, wheat fields, mills, and hiding places when war came; if any road, well, spring, or dock failed, the price would fall first on them.

Entry Fairmarket If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

Stone and wood will decay, but the Beauty Collection still relies on craftsmen to take care of the boats, bridge timbers, millstones, fishing nets and riverside churches, and relies on priests to preserve the memory of the Seven Gods, the legend of the ancient river kings and the land that changed hands repeatedly. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Fairmarket They care about river transportation, ferries, wheat fields, mills, and hiding places when war comes. They also care about whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
